chunks: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said:

A man came to Isa (Jesus), son of Mary (peace be upon him), and said to him: 'O Spirit of Allah, I have committed adultery, so purify me.' Isa (peace be upon him) ordered a call to be made among the people: 'Let no one remain behind; everyone must come out for the purification of so-and-so.' When the people had gathered and the man was in the pit, the man called out: 'Let no one execute the hadd punishment upon me except one who has no prescribed punishment from Allah upon him.' All the people dispersed, except Yahya and Isa (peace be upon them). Yahya (peace be upon him) approached him and said: 'O sinner, advise me.' He said: 'Do not leave your soul alone with its desires, lest it destroys you.' He said: 'Give me more.' He said: 'Do not shame a sinner for his sin.' He said: 'Give me more.' He said: 'Do not become angry.' He said: 'That is enough for me.'

key_terms.لِلَّهِ فِي جَنْبِهِ حَدٌّ: one who has a prescribed punishment from Allah upon him

ai.seo_question: What advice did Prophet Yahya give to the Yahya give to the man who committed adultery according to Imam Al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (as) narrates that Prophet Isa (as) sought to purify a man who committed adultery by calling the public. The man declared that only one who has no hadd (prescribed punishment) of his own should punish him, causing everyone to leave except Yahya and Isa. Yahya then advised the man on three key ethical points: controlling desires, not shaming sinners, and controlling anger.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5019 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

A man came to Isa (as) (Jesus), the son of Mariyum (as) (Mary), and said:
"O' Spirit of Allah (swt), I have committed adultery, so purify me."
Isa (as) ordered a public announcement to be made: "Let no one remain behind; everyone must come out for the purification of this man."
When the people had gathered and the man stood in the pit, the man called out, "Let no one execute the punishment upon me except one who has no prescribed punishment from Allah (swt) upon him."
Upon hearing this, all the people dispersed, leaving only Prophet Yahya (as) and Prophet Isa (as).
Yahya (as) approached the man and said: "O' sinner, advise me."
The man replied: "Do not leave your soul alone with its desires, lest it destroys you."
Yahya (as) said: "Give me more advice."
The man said: "Do not shame a sinner for his sin."
Yahya (as) asked: "Give me more advice."
The man said: "Do not become angry."
Yahya (as) responded, "That is enough for me."
